description: Clean execution-only sell order (Singtel shares). Identity verified, advisor explicitly flags no advice/no suitability check, order read back and explicitly confirmed.
notes: Instruction (sell all 2000 Singtel shares at market) is complete, unambiguous, read back verbatim, and explicitly confirmed -- C03 PASS. This is a plain execution-only equity trade the client initiated on their own; no classification or risk profile is discussed on the call, so C04's classification_match/risk_match sub-criteria have nothing to confirm (CANNOT_DETERMINE, which is the intended, tolerated outcome for those warn_if_unconfirmed sub-criteria -- not a failure). C05 similarly gets a generic risk statement ("risks are entirely for your own account") but no costs/restrictions/losses discussion, so it lands on CANNOT_DETERMINE via rollup_status rather than PASS or FAIL. Nothing here should ever resolve to FAIL/PARTIAL, so escalation stays false. Single action: place the sell order.
